dashboardGroup.name: RAG Agent -- Observability
dashboardGroup.description: Dashboard group for the RAG Agent observability demo stack.

dashboards.name: Service Overview
dashboards.description: At-a-glance service health, request rates, latency, and error breakdown.

charts.name: rag-api Requests
charts.description: Total request count for the rag-api service.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().sum().publish(label='rag-api')

charts.name: surrealdb Requests
charts.description: Total request count for the surrealdb service.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'surrealdb') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().sum().publish(label='surrealdb')

charts.name: playwright-mcp Requests
charts.description: Total request count for the playwright-mcp service.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'playwright-mcp') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().sum().publish(label='playwright-mcp')

charts.name: Error Rate %
charts.description: Percentage of rag-api requests resulting in an error.
charts.programText:
A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev') and filter('sf_error', 'true')).count().publish(label='Errors', enable=False)
B = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().publish(label='Total', enable=False)
C = (A / B * 100).publish(label='Error Rate %')

charts.name: Request Rate
charts.description: Requests per second for the rag-api service.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().rate().publish(label='Request Rate')

charts.name: Service Latency (P50/P90/P99)
charts.description: Request latency percentiles for the rag-api service.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter_).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='P50')
B = histogram('service.request', filter=filter_).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='P90')
C = histogram('service.request', filter=filter_).percentile(pct=99).publish(label='P99')

charts.name: Error Count by Endpoint
charts.description: Top 5 endpoints by error count.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev') and filter('sf_error', 'true')).count().sum(by=['sf_operation']).top(count=5).publish(label='Errors by Endpoint')

charts.name: Top Endpoints
charts.description: Top 10 endpoints by request count.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().top(count=10).publish(label='Top Endpoints')

dashboards.name: RAG Pipeline
dashboards.description: End-to-end RAG flow timing, operation breakdown, and session tracking. Requires Troubleshooting MetricSets (TMS) enabled for rag-api in Splunk APM.

charts.name: RAG Chat Pipeline Latency
charts.description: Duration breakdown of the chat pipeline by step.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'chat.pipeline', 'chat.pipeline.stream')).median().publish(label='Total Chat')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'db.vectorSearch')).median().publish(label='Vector Search')
C = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'chat')).median().publish(label='LLM Completion')
D = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'embeddings')).median().publish(label='Query Embedding')

charts.name: RAG Upload Pipeline Latency
charts.description: Duration breakdown of the upload pipeline by step.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'upload.pipeline')).median().publish(label='Total Upload')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'embeddings')).median().publish(label='Embedding')
C = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'db.insertChunks')).median().publish(label='DB Insert')

charts.name: MCP Scrape Latency
charts.description: End-to-end MCP scrape latency broken down by tool call.
charts.programText:
filter_api = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
filter_mcp = filter('sf_service', 'playwright-mcp') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_api and filter('sf_operation', 'mcp.scrape')).median().publish(label='Total Scrape')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_mcp and filter('sf_operation', 'mcp.tool.browser_navigate')).median().publish(label='Navigate')
C = histogram('spans', filter=filter_mcp and filter('sf_operation', 'mcp.tool.browser_get_text')).median().publish(label='Get Text')

charts.name: Embedding Latency (P50/P90)
charts.description: Embedding API call latency percentiles.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'embeddings')).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='P50')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'embeddings')).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='P90')

charts.name: DB Operation Breakdown
charts.description: Request count by database operation type.
charts.programText: A = histogram('spans', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev') and filter('sf_operation', 'db.vectorSearch', 'db.insertDocument', 'db.insertChunks', 'db.connect', 'db.getDocumentById', 'db.listDocuments', 'db.getStats', 'db.deleteDocument', 'db.deleteAllData', 'db.exportAll', 'db.importAll', 'db.applySchema', 'db.hasDocuments')).count().sum(by=['sf_operation']).publish(label='DB Operations')

charts.name: Vector Search Latency (P50/P90)
charts.description: Vector search latency percentiles.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'db.vectorSearch')).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='P50')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_operation', 'db.vectorSearch')).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='P90')

charts.name: Active Sessions
charts.description: Count of unique session IDs in the current time window.
charts.programText: A = histogram('service.request', filter=filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')).count().sum(by=['session.id']).count().publish(label='Active Sessions')

dashboards.name: LLM and AI
dashboards.description: Token usage, model latency, and AI cost metrics. Latency charts require Troubleshooting MetricSets (TMS) enabled for rag-api in Splunk APM.

charts.name: Total Input Tokens
charts.description: Total input (prompt) tokens consumed in the current time window.
charts.programText: A = data('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'input') and filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).sum().publish(label='Input Tokens')

charts.name: Total Output Tokens
charts.description: Total output (completion) tokens consumed in the current time window.
charts.programText: A = data('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'output') and filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).sum().publish(label='Output Tokens')

charts.name: Token Usage Over Time
charts.description: Input and output token consumption over time.
charts.programText:
A = data('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'input') and filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).sum().publish(label='Input Tokens')
B = data('gen_ai.client.token.usage', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'output') and filter('service.name', 'rag-api')).sum().publish(label='Output Tokens')

charts.name: LLM Call Latency (P50/P90/P99)
charts.description: LLM completion call latency percentiles.
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'chat')).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='P50')
B = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'chat')).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='P90')
C = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'chat')).percentile(pct=99).publish(label='P99')

charts.name: Embedding API Latency
charts.description: Embedding API call latency (median).
charts.programText:
filter_ = filter('sf_service', 'rag-api') and filter('sf_environment', 'dev')
A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_ and filter('gen_ai.operation.name', 'embeddings')).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='P50')

charts.name: Container CPU Usage
charts.description: CPU usage per Docker container (via docker_stats receiver).
charts.programText: A = data('container.cpu.usage.total').publish(label='CPU Usage')

charts.name: Container Memory Usage
charts.description: Memory usage per Docker container (via docker_stats receiver).
charts.programText: A = data('container.memory.usage.total').publish(label='Memory Usage')

charts.name: Container Network I/O
charts.description: Network bytes sent and received per Docker container (via docker_stats receiver).
charts.programText:
A = data('container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes').rate().publish(label='Received bytes/s')
B = data('container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes').rate().publish(label='Sent bytes/s')

charts.name: SurrealDB Process Health
charts.description: CPU and memory usage of the SurrealDB instance.
charts.programText:
A = data('surrealdb.process.cpu_percent', filter=filter('service.name', 'surrealdb')).publish(label='CPU %')
B = data('surrealdb.process.memory', filter=filter('service.name', 'surrealdb')).publish(label='Memory (bytes)')

charts.name: SurrealDB Transaction Rate
charts.description: Transaction throughput (transactions per second).
charts.programText: A = data('surrealdb.transaction', filter=filter('service.name', 'surrealdb')).rate().publish(label='Tx/s')

charts.name: SurrealDB HTTP Activity
charts.description: HTTP request rate and active connections for SurrealDB.
charts.programText:
A = data('surrealdb.http.request', filter=filter('service.name', 'surrealdb')).rate().publish(label='HTTP Req/s')
B = data('surrealdb.http.active_requests', filter=filter('service.name', 'surrealdb')).publish(label='Active Requests')
